# Nonuniform five-type reserve availability — prospective theorem draft

OPEN pending computational verification and scientific closeout. Independently accepted analytical theorem; no new scientific enumeration performed before freeze. Parent weak-trace closeout7c9b6dd2b6b77176cfe9db125ed18276cf513ba0. Same five pair-root maxima M_i, all10 pair roots, positive integer source multiplicities a_i>=1, original palette size A=sum a_i. A graph G sets saturated original floor a_i+a_j on edge ij and floor1 on other roots. Original maximal domination, upper-four protection and original hidden family fixed. Broad C3/general C4/native premises OPEN.

## Static criterion for arbitrary positive multiplicities
A safe static reserve exists iff either G has an isolated vertex, or there is an independent set I in G with |I|>|N_G(I)| containing AT MOST ONE type of source multiplicity1. Equivalent local witnesses for no-isolate five-vertex G:
1. Two degree-one types sharing a neighbor (a cherry), with at least one of the two source multiplicities>=2.
2. An independent triple I with neighborhood size2, with at least two of its three multiplicities>=2.

Necessity: expand each active label of a hypothetical safe static reserve to an original maximal container. The resulting type counts n_i are nonnegative integers with sum n_i<=A-1, and all pair floors hold. All pair roots have floor>=1, so at most one n_i is zero. Let d_i=max(a_i-n_i,0), p_i=max(n_i-a_i,0). Since sum d_i>sum p_i, the integral layer-cake identities imply there is h>=1 with |D_h|>|P_h|, where D_h={i:d_i>=h}, P_h={i:p_i>=h}. Each saturated edge from i in D_h forces n_j-a_j>=a_i-n_i>=h. Thus D_h is independent and N(D_h) subset P_h. Any type in D_h with a_i=1 has n_i=0, so at most one such type exists.

If G has no isolates, N(D_h) is nonempty. On five vertices an independent deficient set has size2,3 or4. Size2 has neighborhood size1 and is a cherry. Size3 with neighborhood1 permits any two of its members as a cherry, choosing at least one multiplicity>=2; size3/neighborhood2 is the triple witness. Size4 has neighborhood1 and also yields an eligible cherry. This yields the two stated local alternatives.

Sufficiency: for any eligible deficient independent I, set n_i=a_i-1 on I, n_i=a_i+1 on N(I), and n_i=a_i elsewhere. Saturated floors hold since every neighbor of a decreased type is increased; no saturated edge joins two decreased types. At most one n_i is zero, so all nonedge floors1 hold and at least four maximal types remain occupied. Their maxima admit an actual four-label cover; thus the static core is safe with fewer than A active labels. The omitted labels are retained as empty labels in the same original palette. An isolated vertex alternatively permits deleting one original label in4 toggles, preserving four anchors from other types.

## Exact reachability criterion and fixed protection
For ALL positive integer a, a first reserve is reachable iff a static reserve exists AND minimum degree(G)<=1. Every reachable case has a route with FOUR unchanged actual original maximal anchors. Thus the uniform theorem extends to all positive nonuniform multiplicities in this five-type pair-root family. No statement yet for other footprint families or sources missing types.

Necessity of a static reserve is immediate. If minimum degree>=2, every original maximal type has a nonempty saturated trace with at least two incident roots, uniquely specifying its maximal container and containing the full allowed saturated trace. The inherited fingerprint invariant applies with the original floors a_i+a_j. Every original label stays active. This argument does not use uniform multiplicity.

Conversely, if there is an isolated vertex, delete a canonical label there in4 toggles. Otherwise choose an eligible cherry or independent triple supplied by the static criterion. For a cherry, its vertices have degree1. For an eligible triple I with N={a,b} and minimum degree<=1, some i in I has degree1: if all three had degree2, both neighborhood vertices would have degree>=3, contrary to the minimum-degree assumption. Choose N(i)={a}, choose j in I\{i} adjacent to b, and let k be the remaining member.

Anchor-selection lemma: a cherry changes two original types; a triple changes three. If at most one changed type has multiplicity1, choose that type as the excluded anchor type; if none is singleton, choose the target type. Freeze the first original label at each of the other four types. For every changed type, edit its first label if that type was excluded, and its second label otherwise. These editable labels exist and are distinct from all anchors. The target may therefore be the SECOND label of a type whose first label remains anchored. This is the needed nonuniform adjustment; exclusion need not equal target.

Cherry (i,a,j): shrink donor from type i to singleton root ia (3 deletions), add root aj (1 addition), delete target from type j (4 deletions). First vacancy at toggle8. Four anchors remain unchanged. Both saturated source edges ia and ja remain compensated; other saturated roots unchanged; nonedge floors follow from the fixed four-anchor cover. Original domination holds. This works for either ordered orientation of any eligible cherry, including a singleton donor with a duplicated target.

Triple (i,a,j,b,k): shrink donor i to ia (3 deletions); add aj iff G-edge; add ak iff G-edge; shrink donor j to jb (3 deletions); add bk iff G-edge; delete target k (4 deletions). All saturated losses are compensated before their deletion, as in the uniform proof. Nonedge floors1 follow from the four unchanged anchors. Original domination and upper-four hold throughout. Both donors retain their singleton roots; the target is the first absent label at the last edit. Cost10+1{aj in G}+degree_G(k)<=13. Every eligible ordered triple works with the adjusted anchor exclusion, even when its degree-one donor is singleton.

Arbitrary original protected hidden completions follow from inherited original-domination/upper-four safety. Floors and labels remain original throughout.

## Cost and obstruction boundaries
An isolated first vacancy has globally optimal cost4. If G has no isolated vertex, ANY first vacancy requires at least8 toggles: at the absent target's original type v choose saturated neighbor w; root vw loses that target but must keep its original a_v+a_w supporters, so an endpoint supporter y originally outside {v,w} must be gained. Domination forces y into M_v or M_w, which intersects its original maximum in one root, so y requires>=3 deletions and>=1 addition. The absent target requires4 deletions. Distinct labels give>=8. Thus eligible cherries achieve the global optimum8 without isolates. Triple<=13 is achieved only, not claimed optimal.

The only no-isolate five-vertex graphs admitting a deficient independent set but having minimum degree>=2 are the20 labelled K23 graphs with an optional edge between the size-two part. With nonuniform positive multiplicities, these graphs have a static reserve iff at least two vertices of their independent size-three part have multiplicity>=2. No formula for their general static minimum is claimed here. When this condition holds the static reserve is unreachable; otherwise static absence is itself obstructed. Other statically infeasible graphs can have weak traces; weak traces alone are not a reserve theorem.

## Frozen complete finite verification contract
1. All1024 labelled graphs G and ALL32 positive source profiles a in{1,2}^5, with actual palette offsets and original edge floors a_i+a_j:32768 cases. Independently reconstruct every complete count-graph vertex/exact-meet edge/component/static minimum/source component. Compare full canonical identities before hashes. Verify static criterion, reachability iff static and minimum degree<=1, fingerprint/COUNT-GRAPH-source-isolation equivalence (not raw native-state isolation), and exact capacity-conditioned K23 obstruction identities. The all-positive-integer statement rests on the proof, not this finite binary-profile campaign. A count-isolated source can still permit safe unlocked-root native edits; no native singleton-component claim is made.
2. For every such(G,a), every isolated type gets4 edits; every ordered eligible cherry gets8; every ordered eligible triple (i,a,j,b,k) in no-isolate minimum-degree1 graphs gets the stated<=13 route. Canonical anchor exclusion is the unique changed singleton type if present, otherwise target. Editable label is first at excluded type, second at other changed types; first labels at the four nonexcluded types are anchors. Ascending root deletion order, additions aj,ak then bk. Include singleton donors/duplicated targets explicitly. Not every actual label choice/edit order.
3. Every native slice and every original protected one-hidden mask, deduplicated by(G,a,core), separate occurrences. Exact palette/floors/domination/upper-four/anchor immutability, first vacancy and achieved/optimal flags. Independently reconstruct every declared count vertex/static minimum vector and every eligible local certificate, including its canonical ±1 witness. This does not enumerate arbitrary labelled native static cores, all actual label choices or all edit orders; no supplied case lists. Reject profile/G/source/floor/count/vertex/edge/component/anchor/excluded-type/edit/hidden-mask omissions/corruptions, unsafe two-singleton cherry, insufficient-capacity triple and missing required saturated compensation. Preserve all480 lower-bound footprint witnesses.
4. Genuine RED before implementation, new GREEN plus344 inherited scientific tests. Fresh full byte-identical certificate/canonical companion and complete independent reconstruction. Separate mathematical and publication reviews, exact-event CI, original unchanged archive bytes/full logs/raw answers/input hashes/failures, author adjudication and separate final publication audit. Both continuation indices and immutable text/binary/head readback before scoped closeout. No broad C3/general C4/native premise closeout.

## Prospective analytical review
A fresh independent reviewer ACCEPTED the layer-cake static criterion, local witness reduction, nonuniform fingerprint/count-isolation argument, singleton-donor anchor selection, eight-toggle bound and capacity-conditioned K23 obstruction, without enumeration or edits. The author incorporated explicit count-source isolation and canonical count/local static-witness scope clarifications before freeze.

# Universal core-region criterion and reserved-label bypass — closeout

Status: scoped theorem CLOSED. Exact repair on the saturated disjoint-role template is OBSTRUCTED with only active labels and CONSTRUCTIVE with one reserved unused core label. Broad C3/general C4 remain OPEN. No numbered v16 or full-stack/post-merge certification is claimed.

## Scientific discovery

For an original finite nonempty core C with hitting number 3 or 4, positive original floors at most core sizes, and ALL protected completions by a disjoint nonempty hidden palette, a candidate core D is universally admissible exactly when:

1. Its core supports satisfy the original floors.
2. Its core hitting number is at most 4.
3. Every current core-label footprint is contained in some original core-label footprint (empty footprints allowed).

This removes the hidden-completion quantifier from this safety decision. Necessity uses a single hidden label on the complement of a violating footprint; sufficiency replaces current core hits by original core hits and leaves hidden hits unchanged. The original C remains the reference throughout a path. Arbitrarily many hidden labels are covered by the proof, not by extrapolation from the finite census. The criterion decides admissibility, not general connectivity or native observer origin.

The saturated template has m roots with {A}, two singleton roles {B}, {C}, and host {D,E}. With only these five active labels it has NO uniformly safe first edit across its full source fiber: deletion violates a floor in the empty-hidden world; every valid addition mixes disjoint original footprints. With one reserved globally absent core label w, use +w at host, remove D there, add D at ALL m A-roots, remove A at ALL those roots, add A at host, and remove w. Every slice is universally safe and the endpoint exactly exchanges A,D while preserving hidden incidences.

The route uses 2m+4 committed toggles, the sharp uniform minimum: 2m+2 endpoint differences plus at least two off-endpoint toggles. Peak excess is max(1,m), not a single-excess claim. Current core and the supplied ordered template identify the next request and exact endpoint. Optional NOOPs can stall forever; no physical progress law is derived.

This does not make the previous fixed-family admission predicate true. The hidden common label can persist while the SAME intended exact repair destination is reached by another route. Buffer choreography was already known; the new result is the exact universal criterion and its full-completion operational application, including resource necessity and uniform optimality. Core access, static addresses, original protected-band knowledge and reserved-label availability remain explicit premises.

- [Prospective scope/proof freeze](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/49227fd7c18fe4ec358817102e1e31ff43d8c965).

Universally safe counts are 60, 6, 6, 24 respectively. The m=3 repair is checked on all 53 protected one-hidden-label completions, through all 11 slices (ten edits). These are executed counts, not prospective analytical predictions.

All 50 tests pass: four positive contracts, two explicit native rejecting controls, 16 corrupted-certificate controls, and 28 inherited fixed-family tests. # Anchored donor release and exact-permutation restoration — scoped closeout

Status: **CLOSED for the declared two-stage monotone-release theorem and its exact verification contract.** Broad C3/general C4, native observer/core access, source admission, outcome selection, and guaranteed progress remain OPEN. This is not numbered-v16 or full-stack certification.

## Mathematical result

For a finite original core `C`, active palette `P`, fixed positive original floors, and `3 <= tau(C) <= 4`, fix an occupied reserve label `r`. A two-stage path that first adds only non-`r` donor incidences and then deletes every original `r` incidence exists uniformly over every original protected hidden completion exactly when each donor `d != r` can be assigned to an inclusion-maximal original footprint `phi(d)` such that:

1. its original footprint is contained in `phi(d)`;
2. the assigned donor incidences satisfy every original floor; and
3. at most four assigned donor footprints cover all roots.

The construction is explicit. Add donor incidences within their assigned original footprints, then delete `r`. Original floors, original-footprint domination, and an actual upper-four cover hold at every slice. This criterion is exact only for the declared monotone class; its failure is not a general connectivity obstruction.

Once `r` is absent, whole-footprint renames implement any exact palette permutation, including one moving `r`. Concatenating the release path, the rename path, and the reverse of the permuted release path reaches exactly the labelled endpoint `pi(C)`, fixes every hidden incidence, and removes all preparatory donor incidences in their prescribed images. Relabelling the same certificate renews the interface for any finite prescribed permutation sequence.

The saturated multi-donor example `({r,a},{r,b},{a,c},{b,d},{e})` shows the new mechanism: two donors protect distinct maximal regions, so a common donor backbone is unnecessary.

Status: **CLOSED for the declared universally safe core-connectivity theorem and its verification contract.** Broad C3/general C4, native observer/access/source/outcome/progress and universal one-excess-incidence repair remain OPEN. No numbered-stage or full-stack certification.

## Exact mathematical result
For a finite original core with active labelled palette, fixed positive floors at most original root sizes and original hitting number 3..4, let M be its inclusion-maximal original label footprints. Keep ALL original protected hidden completions fixed.

Build vertices by assigning each existing label a member of M or the empty footprint, subject to original floors and an actual at-most-four-label cover. Join two vertices differing in one label exactly when their intersection core satisfies those same conditions. Original-footprint domination follows by construction.

Two uniformly safe labelled cores are connected by safe single incidence toggles **if and only if** their maximal expansions lie in the same assignment component. The expansion choices do not affect the answer. Proof constructs both directions: expand source; compress incidence edits, handling empty bridges; lift handover edges by deletion to their safe intersection then addition inside the new original container; reverse target expansion to reach the EXACT labelled destination. Every original hidden completion stays safe, with no reset, hidden read/write, new label/root or floor relaxation.

Such a path, followed by inherited absent-label renaming and reverse of its permuted release path, implements any exact core-label permutation and restores every preparatory incidence in its prescribed image. The interface renews for finite permutation sequences.

# Saturated fingerprints: exact motion without transferable reserve, and an unlocked boundary

2026-10-10 UTC. Prospective theorem and verification contract, OPEN pending scientific closeout. Integrated parent347100f9da88575f929faabf8a00f77a5786f542.

## Original setting
Use the inherited finite core, active palette P of N identities, positive original floors F, source hitting number in{3,4}, fixed ORIGINAL protected hidden completions and actual single-incidence toggles. Universal safety is exactly original floors, core hitting number<=4 and each current footprint contained in an ORIGINAL footprint. Original observation/access/source/outcome and committed progress remain supplied. No source-fiber reset, fresh label or new primitive.

This checkpoint investigates redundant maximal footprints after PRIVATE ruled out forced first-reserve cover movement in an irredundant maximal family. It proves a reusable obstruction and a contrasting unlocked construction; it does NOT exhibit forced cover movement before a first reserve or close general redundant-maxima availability.

## Theorem1: saturated-fingerprint lock and exact labelled component
Let M be all maximal original footprints and K a subset of roots whose ORIGINAL floors equal their source cardinalities. For each original active label x, let L_x be its original footprint restricted to K. Require:
(a) L_x is nonempty;
(b) exactly ONE maximum M_x contains L_x;
(c) M_x intersect K equals L_x.
Condition(c) is important: uniqueness alone does not prevent safe additions at locked roots.

All original incidences on K are immutable along every safe path. Induct on the first edit there: with K unchanged, the label being edited retains L_x, so original domination forces its entire footprint into its unique M_x. An addition at K is impossible by(c), since all allowed locked incidences are already present. A deletion violates that root's still-saturated original floor. Thus no first locked edit exists. All labels retain nonempty L_x, so no reserve is reachable, even with moving covers or nonmonotone safe local edits.

More precisely, the source component is EXACTLY all universally safe labelled cores Q with locked incidences equal to the source and every label x confined to M_x. Necessity is the invariant. For sufficiency take the coordinatewise join of Q and source S. It is within each M_x and has the same locked incidences. Add S-to-join incidences, then delete join-to-Q incidences. First-leg cores contain S and second-leg cores contain Q, so floors and the upper-cover bound hold; original domination holds throughout. The inherited criterion protects ALL original hidden completions. Any two cores in this component connect in the same way through their join. Each differing incidence is changed once; achieved native toggle count equals Hamming distance and is therefore minimal for that exact labelled pair. This claim concerns actual toggles; supplied commitment is not derived.

This is an exact component certificate, not a classification of sources lacking the certificate. Safe local motion and optimal exact motion inside a component do not imply transferable reserve.

## Theorem2: pair-root count criterion
Use five maximal footprint types indexed0..4, one root for EVERY unordered pair{i,j}, and M_i consisting of all pairs incident to i. At the source each type has t original labels with footprint M_i, t>=1. Source N=5t and core hitting number4: four types cover all pairs, while any three omit a pair. Maxima are redundant (k5>tau4).

Choose ANY simple graph G on the five types. Original floor at pair{i,j} is2t if it is an edge of G, otherwise1. Locked roots K are the edges of G. The fingerprint certificate holds iff every vertex of G has degree>=2: two distinct incident pair roots identify their unique common type; one identifies two types and zero gives an empty fingerprint. Full locked traces condition(c) holds at this source.

The entire unrestricted count graph has counts n_0 for empty and n_i for five maximal types, of total5t. Feasibility is n_i+n_j>=F_ij for all pairs. Positive pair floors force at least four occupied types; the core upper-four gate is automatic at these vertices. For a transfer i->j, exact-meet safety requires n_i+n_l>=F_il+1 for every l!=i,j. For deletion i->empty it requires this strict inequality for EVERY l!=i. Other pair inequalities are unchanged. These meet cores also admit actual four-covers: an unaffected four-type cover, or the three unaffected types plus the donor's pair{i,j} intersection when the destination type was empty. Verify these against the inherited gate; floors alone are not asserted sufficient for arbitrary raw cores.

If a transfer removes the last donor occupant when exactly four types were occupied, positive-floor meet inequalities force the destination to be the unique empty type: otherwise the donor and old empty type leave their pair root uncovered. The three unchanged maxima plus the donor singleton pair cover the meet. A deletion cannot remove the last donor occupant from four occupied types; a deletion from five occupied types may do so safely.

At the uniform source n_i=t, a departure from type i is allowed only when all its saturated neighbors lie in the one destination type. Therefore the source count vertex has no edge iff min degree(G)>=2. This matches the fingerprint certificate exactly in THIS declared pair-root family. The raw source may still have safe deletions at any unlocked pair. When G is not complete and the certificate holds, such motion does not permit a vacancy. The complete exact labelled component remains the safe subset described in Theorem1, not every floor-valid raw core.

## Theorem3: unbounded static surplus behind a lock
Take G=K_{2,3} with parts{0,1} and{2,3,4}. Its six cross-pair roots have floors2t; its four within-part roots have floors1. Every label has two or three immutable locked incidences. For all t>=1 the static minimum active count is4t+1; source count5t is inaccessible to any vacancy.

Proof of static minimum: let m be the minimum of the three right-type counts. If1<=m<=2t, both left counts are>=2t-m, and right sum>=3m, giving total>=4t+m>=4t+1. If m=0, the other two right counts are>=1 by their pair floors and both left counts are>=2t, giving>=4t+2. If m>2t, right sum alone is>=6t+3>4t+1. The vector(2t-1,2t-1,1,1,1) attains4t+1. Original domination reduces every arbitrary static candidate to maximal types, so this is also the full static minimum, not just a graph relaxation.

For t>=2 there is a universally safe static endpoint on the SAME palette with t-1 absent labels, yet no vacancy is reachable. Static surplus t-1 is unbounded. All maximal donors fail anchored-release certificates. There are safe first changes at the unlocked roots. For t1 static minimumN=5, so no static reserve. Core hitting number of every safe core is4; protected FULL hidden completions remain3..4.

## Theorem4: one identifying incidence allows a first reserve
Take G the star centered0, with leaves1..4. Cross floors are2t, leaf-pair floors1. Center fingerprints are unique; leaf fingerprints have two possible maxima, so the lock certificate fails. For t>=2 select one non-anchor label in EACH of two distinct leaf blocks. Transfer each footprint from its leaf maximum to the center maximum by deleting its three leaf-only incidences, then adding the three center-only incidences. Keep one original maximal label from each leaf block unchanged; these FOUR actual labels cover every pair root throughout.

The two transfers take12 toggles, raise the center multiplicity from t to t+2, and lower two leaf counts to t-1. Delete the four incidences of one center label. Every cross floor then has multiplicity at least(t+1)+(t-1)=2t, and leaf-pair floors remain met. This achieves a FIRST vacancy in16 toggles, with all original floors and a persistent actual four-cover. The earlier12 slices keep all labels active. No optimal-first-vacancy cost claim.

More generally transfer all t-1 non-anchor labels from each of the four leaf blocks to the center, then delete3t-3 center labels. Proof: with minimum leaf m>=1, center>=max(0,2t-m) and leaf sum>=4m, giving>=2t+3; with one leaf zero, center>=2t and other leaves>=1, also>=2t+3. Positive pair floors forbid two zero types. The bound is attained by(2t-1,1,1,1,1). The batch route reaches that minimum in36(t-1) toggles, under the unchanged four leaf anchors. Achieved surplus3t-3 is unbounded for t>=2. The t1 member has static minimumN=5 and no reserve.

At the original star source all labels are maximal and every donor meets a saturated cross root. Anchored preparations cannot add outside an unchanged maximal footprint, so EVERY anchored release fails, although the constructed nonmonotone route succeeds. This is a mixed-floor source; not all original floors are saturated. Final leaf-pair cardinalities can decrease while preserving floors; no cardinality-restoration claim for the capacity endpoint. Inherited borrowing/permutation/restoration and finite renewal apply after the vacancy, with no new permutation campaign claimed.
